test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A boat takes 39 minutes to go 27.9 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 9 : 4. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 18.9 km upstream and 51.3 km downstream?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream speed (U) = 27.9 ÷ (39/60) = 42.92 kmph. Ratio speed: Water (x) = 9k, Stream (y) = 4k.

Upstream speed U = x − y = 5k. Downstream speed D = x + y = 13k.

Since 5k = 42.92, k = 8.584. U = 42.92, D = 13 × 8.584 = 111.592.

Time = (18.9 ÷ 42.92) + (51.3 ÷ 111.592) ≈ 0.44 + 0.46 = 0.9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.9 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a951b318b007e582667ccdb0158f941579b5d7872b36615ea0889f94ac7ea170.png] 

**Given:**

Distance upstream₁ = 27.9 km, Time₁ = 39 min = 39/60 hours.

Ratio of **Speed of Boat (x)** to **Speed of Stream (y)** = 9 : 4.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Upstream speed (U) = Distance / Time = 27.9 ÷ (39/60) = (27.9 × 60) ÷ 39 = 1674 ÷ 39 = 42.923 kmph.

⇒ Let x = 9k and y = 4k. Then U = x − y = 5k.

⇒ 5k = 42.923 ⇒ k = 8.5846.

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = x + y = 13k = 13 × 8.5846 = 111.6 kmph.

⇒ Time for 18.9 km upstream = 18.9 ÷ 42.923 ≈ 0.44 hours.

⇒ Time for 51.3 km downstream = 51.3 ÷ 111.6 ≈ 0.46 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.44 + 0.46 = 0.9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.9 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream Speed (U) = x − y and Downstream Speed (D) = x + y, where x is boat speed in still water and y is stream speed.

Speed Components

Boat speed in still water x = (D + U) ÷ 2 and Stream speed y = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

Average Speed = (U × D) / x = (x² − y²) / x kmph.</p
